tasks.label: Run API (http://localhost:4000/docs)
tasks.command: [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || { echo 'No .venv yet: run the "Setup: create .venv and install dependencies" task first.'; exit 1; }; .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000 --reload

tasks.label: Stop API (free port 4000)
tasks.command: pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:4000 -sTCP:LISTEN); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill $pids && echo "Stopped process(es) $pids on port 4000"; else echo 'Nothing is listening on port 4000'; fi

tasks.label: Quality checks: lint + types + tests
tasks.command: [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || { echo 'No .venv yet: run the "Setup: create .venv and install dependencies" task first.'; exit 1; }; .venv/bin/ruff check app tests && .venv/bin/ruff format --check app tests && .venv/bin/mypy app && .venv/bin/pytest
